name: punk-text-image-converter
title_zh: 长文进，三平台竖版图文出，中间只等你点一次头
tagline_zh: 公众号长文塞进小红书/抖音太费劲？它直接出5张3:4海报让你挑，选中后自动排版20页内图文。
tagline_en: Stop reformatting essays for 小红书/抖音. It drafts 5 posters, you pick one, it builds a ≤20-page deck and writes.
desc_en: Read a long Markdown article, generate five complete 3:4 modernist editorial cover posters directly as raster PNGs with Image 2, wait for the user to select one, build a matching HTML-to-PNG article deck of no more than 20 pages, then prepare three platform-specific publishing-copy options after asking whether the target is 公众号、抖音 or 小红书. Use for 公众号贴图、短视频图文、小红书竖版知识卡片 and Swiss / International Typ
why_zh: 把「选封面」这个唯一需要人判断的节点前置，之后排版、切页、写文案全自动，且严格限制页数逼出信息密度。
why_en: The only human judgment call—cover selection—happens first. Everything downstream (layout, pagination, captions) is.
limit_zh: 只认 Markdown 长文输入；封面用 Image 2 生成，需要你本地有对应 API 权限。
limit_en: Markdown only; needs Image 2 API access; outputs PNG/HTML snapshots, no editable files; captions only for WeChat, Douyin, Xiaohongshu.
title_en: Long Markdown in, 3 platform-ready vertical decks out.
